title: User Registration with Email and SMS Phone Verification
description: Verify that a new user can successfully register with valid email and password, complete phone verification via SMS, and receive confirmation email.

steps.description: Navigate to registration page
Enter valid email, password, and phone number
Submit registration form
Check confirmation email is sent
Enter correct SMS verification code received on phone
Check phone number is verified successfully
Check user is able to login after verification

title: User Login Success with Correct Credentials
description: Verify that users can log in with correct email and password and session tokens are issued securely.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter valid registered email and correct password
Click login button
Check user is redirected to dashboard
Check secure session token is granted

title: Login Failure with Incorrect Password
description: Verify system prevents login with incorrect password and shows appropriate error message without revealing sensitive information.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter valid registered email and incorrect password
Click login button
Check login fails
Check error message displayed is generic and non-revealing

title: Profile Completion and Avatar Upload
description: Verify that a lawyer can successfully complete profile including Baro Number, City, Specializations and upload a valid avatar image.

steps.description: Login as registered lawyer user
Navigate to profile completion/editing page
Enter valid Baro Number, City, and Specializations
Upload valid avatar image file
Save profile changes
Check that profile details are saved and appear correctly on profile page
Check avatar image is displayed properly

title: Job Creation with Urgent Marking and Location Selection
description: Verify lawyers can create new jobs specifying type, location, fee, and mark jobs as urgent with correct input validation.

steps.description: Login as lawyer user
Navigate to job creation page
Enter valid job title, select courthouse/location from provided list
Set job fee and mark job as urgent
Submit job creation form
Check job is saved with all specified attributes including urgent flag
Verify job appears in user's job list

title: Job Listing with Filtering by City and Job Type
description: Verify that job listings can be filtered by city and job type correctly and display accurate job details.

steps.description: Navigate to job listings page
Select a city filter
Select a job type filter
Verify that displayed jobs match selected city and job type filters
Click on a job to view details
Verify that job details including application deadlines and fees are shown correctly

title: Job Application for Urgent and Standard Jobs within Application Windows
description: Verify that users can apply for both urgent and standard jobs only within their respective application windows and job owners receive notifications on timeout.

steps.description: Login as lawyer user
Navigate to job listing
Select an urgent job within application window
Submit job application
Check application is accepted
Select a standard job after the application window has closed
Attempt to submit job application
Check application is rejected due to timeout
Verify job owner received automated notification about timeout

title: Premium Subscription Purchase Success with Garanti BBVA 3D Secure
description: Verify that premium subscription plans can be purchased securely through Garanti BBVA 3D Secure payment gateway and success flow redirects correctly.

steps.description: Login as registered user
Navigate to premium subscription page
Select monthly subscription plan
Proceed to payment and complete 3D Secure authentication successfully
Check payment success callback is received
Verify user's premium status is updated and enabled
Check redirection to payment success page

title: Premium Subscription Payment Failure Handling
description: Verify the system properly handles payment failure scenarios during premium subscription purchase including 3D Secure failure and network errors.

steps.description: Login as registered user
Navigate to premium subscription page
Select yearly subscription plan
Attempt payment and simulate 3D Secure authentication failure
Check payment failure callback is received
Verify premium status remains unchanged
Check redirection to payment failed page

title: Notification Delivery via SMS, Push, and Telegram
description: Verify that job-related notifications are sent and received correctly on user-selected channels (SMS, Firebase push, Telegram bot).

steps.description: Login as user with notification preferences set for SMS, push, and Telegram
Trigger a job event such as new application received or job update
Verify SMS notification is received on registered phone
Verify push notification appears via Firebase/FCM
Verify Telegram message is received via integrated bot

title: Admin Dashboard Metrics Accuracy and Access Control
description: Verify that only admin users can access admin dashboard and metrics shown accurately reflect real-time platform data.

steps.description: Login as admin user
Navigate to admin dashboard
Check dashboard loads without errors
Verify metrics such as user count, active jobs, premium users are displayed accurately
Logout and login as a normal user
Attempt to access admin dashboard
Verify access is denied with appropriate error or redirect

title: Admin User Management - Suspension and Filtering
description: Verify admin can view, filter users by criteria, and suspend user accounts successfully.

steps.description: Login as admin
Navigate to admin user management page
Filter users by city and role
Verify filtered users list matches criteria
Select a user and suspend their account
Verify user's account status is updated and they cannot login

title: Automated Cron Jobs Execution
description: Verify cron jobs trigger at scheduled intervals to perform tasks including job bot synthetic activity, application window monitoring, and premium expiry notifications.

steps.description: Ensure cron jobs scheduler is running
Simulate passing of scheduled time for job application window monitoring
Verify job application windows expire as expected and timeout notifications send
Simulate premium subscription expiry approaching
Verify premium expiry notification is dispatched
Check synthetic job creation by job bots executes as scheduled and is reflected in job list

title: Security - Supabase RLS and Role-Based Access Enforcement
description: Verify Row Level Security policies prevent unauthorized data access and role-based access restricts admin routes to admins only.

steps.description: Login as regular user
Attempt to access another user's private job or profile data via API or UI
Verify access is denied according to RLS policies
Try to access admin-restricted routes
Verify user is blocked or redirected

title: Payment Security - 3D Secure Payment Hash Verification
description: Verify the system validates payment hash with Garanti BBVA 3D Secure gateway properly to prevent tampering and fraud.

steps.description: Initiate premium subscription payment
Intercept and modify payment hash in callback payload (simulate tampering)
Submit modified payment success callback
Verify the system rejects the callback as invalid
Verify premium subscription is not activated erroneously

title: Password Reset Flow with Email Confirmation
description: Verify users can successfully request password reset, receive email with reset link, and update password securely.

steps.description: Navigate to password reset page
Enter registered email to request password reset
Check reset email is sent with valid link
Open reset link and enter new valid password
Submit new password
Verify password is updated and user can login with new password

title: User Notification Preferences Management
description: Verify users can view, update and save notification channel preferences for SMS, push, and Telegram.

steps.description: Login as user
Navigate to notification settings page
Toggle notification preferences for SMS, push, and Telegram
Save preferences
Verify preferences are saved and reflected on reload

title: Admin Dispute Resolution Workflow
description: Verify admin can view, investigate, and resolve user disputes with appropriate status updates and notifications.

steps.description: Login as admin
Navigate to dispute management page
Select an active dispute
Update dispute status and add resolution notes
Mark dispute as resolved
Verify dispute status updates accordingly
Verify users involved receive notification of resolution

title: Edge Case - Job Creation with Empty or Invalid Fields
description: Verify system prevents job creation if required fields are empty or contain invalid data and displays appropriate error messages.

steps.description: Login as lawyer user
Navigate to job creation page
Leave required fields empty or enter invalid fee (e.g. negative number)
Attempt to submit job creation form
Verify validation errors are displayed for each invalid field
Verify job is not created

title: UI Responsiveness and Navigation Bar Mobile Menu
description: Verify that the main navigation bar renders correctly on mobile devices and mobile menu toggles as expected.

steps.description: Open the application on a mobile device or simulate mobile viewport
Verify navigation bar is responsive and content fits screen
Click on mobile menu toggle button
Verify mobile menu expands and shows navigation links
Click on a menu item
Verify navigation to selected page occurs
